name: pgyer-mcp-server

tools.name: upload_app
tools.description: Upload an Android (.apk), iOS (.ipa) or HarmonyOS (.hap) package from this machine to PGYER and wait until PGYER has processed it. Returns the published build with its download page URL (share it with testers) and QR code image URL. PGYER matches the package to an existing app by its package identifier, or creates the app on the first upload. Only the settings you pass are changed; the app keeps its current values for the rest. Large files can take several minutes. If PGYER is still processing when processingTimeoutSeconds ends, the result has status "processing" and a buildKey: call get_upload_status with it later instead of uploading again.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the .apk, .ipa or .hap file on this machine

updateDescription.description: Release notes for this build, shown on the download page

description.description: App description shown on the download page

installType.description: Who can install: public (anyone with the link), password (needs the install password) or invite (only invited testers). Setting only password implies password.

installStartDate.description: First day the build can be installed (YYYY-MM-DD); set together with installEndDate

installEndDate.description: Last day the build can be installed (YYYY-MM-DD); set together with installStartDate

channelShortcut.description: Shortcut of a PGYER channel download link to publish this build to

oversea.description: true: upload through the overseas network; false: upload within mainland China. Leave out to let PGYER choose by IP address.

processingTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for PGYER to process the build after the file is uploaded (default 600)

tools.name: get_upload_status
tools.description: Check whether PGYER has finished processing an upload, by the buildKey that upload_app returned with status "processing". Returns the published build with its download page URL once it is ready. Set waitSeconds to keep checking for up to that long.

waitSeconds.description: Keep checking every few seconds for up to this many seconds (default 0: check once)

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the apps in the PGYER account, 20 per page, with each app's latest version and download page. Use page to see more; pageCount tells how many pages there are.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get an app's details by appKey or by shortcut (or a full https://www.pgyer.com/<shortcut> URL): latest version, download page, QR code, install type, install period and download page settings. Pass buildKey together with appKey to get one specific historical build. The install password is never returned.

shortcut.description: Download page shortcut or URL, e.g. "abcd" or "https://www.pgyer.com/abcd"

buildKey.description: A specific build of the app (only with appKey)

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the uploaded versions (builds) of an app, newest first, by appKey or shortcut. isLatest shows which build carries PGYER's latest-version mark. Use page to see older builds.

tools.name: set_latest_version
tools.description: Mark a build as the latest version of its app (latest: true, the default), or remove the latest-version mark from it (latest: false). Get build keys from list_versions. Ask the user before changing which build is marked latest.

latest.description: true (default): set as latest. false: remove the latest mark.

tools.name: update_app_settings
tools.description: Change an app's download page and installation settings. Only the settings you pass change; the rest keep their current values. Use dryRun to see which settings would change without saving.

installStartDate.description: First day the app can be installed (YYYY-MM-DD); set together with installEndDate

installEndDate.description: Last day the app can be installed (YYYY-MM-DD); set together with installStartDate

removeInstallPeriod.description: true: remove the install period limit

versionSource.description: Show PGYER build numbers (pgyer) or the package version code (app) on the download page

showPgyerCopyright.description: Show the PGYER copyright on the download page

dryRun.description: true: only report what would change

instructions:
PGYER (pgyer.com) distributes Android, iOS and HarmonyOS test builds to testers.
- upload_app publishes a local .apk, .ipa or .hap file and returns its download page URL and QR code URL; share those with testers.
- An appKey identifies an app and a buildKey identifies one uploaded version. Get them from list_apps, get_app or list_versions.
- A shortcut is the last part of a download page URL: https://www.pgyer.com/<shortcut>.
- Settings you leave out keep their current values.
